title: Frisply Clover
body:
The Frisply Clover was formerly a limited time tree that only spawned during the Saint Patrick's Day event. However, it now is permanently obtainable, though, in scarcer quantity except during the event. The clover, as its name indicates, is a massive four-leaf clover that only spawns in the desert regions of the map.

Description

The Frisply Clover was added as part of the Saint Patrick's Day event alongside the Gold Coin and many other items. This tree requires a Rusty Axe or above to chop.

Trivia

  • As of v1.5.4(04/14/23), the tree was brought back to permanently stay in the game.
